General Comments: These are sensors that will be installed on the pipes (inlets). Some of them are installed in the middle of the pipe, some others on top of the pipe and the other ones on the inlet. The strategy will be the following: calibrate the 12 sensors with the old boards 2 or 3 times. Then change the boards of the UP and MIDDLE sensors for the new ones. Some adaptors have been fabricated in order to let all the sensors at the same height inside the capsule. Calibrate these 8 replaced with the 8 DOWN with the old boards 2 times. Then Calibrate these 8 with 4 sensors from the TGradient. Finallly, change the DOWN sensors for the new INLET sensors and calibrate them with the 8 UP and MIDDLE with the new boards.
